annotations.title: Price elasticity and profit maximizing price

description: Estimate how sensitive buyers are to price from two comparable periods and find the price that maximizes profit. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

p2.description: Price in period B. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

q2.description: Units sold in period B. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.
